responsibility: This utility processes target.def and related target hook definition files to generate either default target-hook initializer macros or Texinfo hook documentation. It materializes the hook table from DEFHOOK/DEFHOOKPOD forms, emits target-hooks-def.h macro definitions that fill targetm structures with default implementations, and in documentation mode merges @hook placement markers from an input manual with hook signatures, grouped declarations, and doc strings to produce target-hooks.texi-style output.
